lesson.title: 4.15 Are there any books on the sofa?
lesson.unit_title: Life at home, every day and yesterday
lesson.unit_outcome: Say where people and things are at home, talk about the lights and machines, ask what there is, describe someone's morning in order, say what you did yesterday and on which day, ask and tell the time, say how often you do things and give dates.
lesson.lesson_title: Are there any books on the sofa?
lesson.sub_lesson_title: Are there any books on the sofa?
lesson.goal: Say there are some things somewhere, ask Are there any…? and say there aren't any (Are there any books on the sofa? No, there aren't any.).
lesson.grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 4.15 More at Home: A1 names more of the home; A1+ 4.15 adds some and any to 4.4's there is, there are and Are there…?: some in a positive sentence (There are some apples on the table.), any in a question and after aren't (Are there any books on the sofa? No, there aren't any.), with How many … are there? Six new Flash photos show three places with the things and the same places without them (each empty photo is an edit of its full one), and A1 4.4's books on a table and bags under a table come back. An any sentence is never set against a photo of another place, where it would also be true.
lesson.prerequisite: A1 4.4 and 4.15 there is, there are, home; A1 5.4 some; A1+ 4.4 Is there…? / Are there…? and How many.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Link there are (THEH-rar) and say some and any unstressed before the noun (sum APPLES, enee BOOKS). Do not require native-like speed.
